about.heading: About
about.body: Senior AI-Augmented .NET Developer and Solution Architect with 15+ years of hands-on experience building enterprise-grade applications using C#, ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Core, .NET Web APIs, React, Azure, and AI-assisted SDLC tooling (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Amazon Q, MCP). Operates as a forward-deployed engineer — embedded inside client engineering teams to design and ship custom solutions. Broad domain expertise across BFSI, Insurance, Travel, Utilities, Healthcare, and Enterprise HR/Payroll, with proven delivery for Fortune 500 customers in the USA and UK.
